concurrency_and_state: Main.cs mixes three Unity callbacks for core state: FixedUpdate() drives Rms.update(), GameCanvas.update(), Image.update(), DataInputStream.update() via a gameSpeedAccumulator loop; Update() drives Session_ME.update() and Session_ME2.update(); OnGUI() drives checkInput() and GameCanvas.paint(g).

Image.cs contains an unsynchronized single-slot static IPC mailbox (status, imgTemp, filenametemp, datatemp, imgSrcTemp, xtemp, ytemp, wtemp, htemp, transformtemp) polled with Thread.Sleep(5) up to 500x in private _createImage* methods and serviced in Image.update() on the main thread; status is non-volatile and lacks locking, though public createImage methods currently bypass it and call __createImage directly.

Main.Awake() checks `if (main != null)` to destroy duplicate MonoBehaviours, but `main = this` is only assigned later inside FixedUpdate()->setsizeChange() after `count >= 10`, leaving a 10-tick window where duplicate Main instances are not destroyed.

GameCanvas.cs holds ~90 mutable static globals (currentScreen, currentDialog, panel, panel2, keyPressed/keyHold/keyReleased, pointer flags, imgBG/yb/bgW/bgH) accessed across Main.OnGUI, Main.FixedUpdate, and action callbacks without synchronization.
cross_module_questions: Does any external script invoke Image._createImage* via reflection, or is the entire static status/imgTemp mailbox dead code that can be removed from Main.FixedUpdate()?

How does Service.gI() handle `Session_ME` vs `Session_ME2` when `Controller.isMain` flips in `GameCanvas.update()` (lines 769-828), especially when `OnApplicationFocus(false)` drops `Update()` to 15 FPS?
Where is `Main.gameSpeed` modified at runtime, and how does `gameSpeedAccumulator` in `Main.FixedUpdate()` interact with server-side movement/attack cooldown validation?
Does `mFont.bigNumber_black` (id 31) get called anywhere when `mGraphics.zoomLevel > 1`, which would trigger `IndexOutOfRangeException` in `mFont.setTypePaint()`?

db_redis_touchpoints.op: Client local RMS persistence (Rms.Init, Rms.update, Rms.loadRMS/Int/String, Rms.saveRMSInt/saveIP, Rms.clearAll)
db_redis_touchpoints.safety_note: Main.doClearRMS() (Main.cs:427-439) calls Rms.clearAll() whenever `lastZoomlevel != mGraphics.zoomLevel` on PC, wiping saved client settings/RMS cache on zoom change.

findings.impact: Every frame when a panel is open without an active chat field, panel.updateKey() or panel2.updateKey() executes twice per tick, causing double-clicks, double-scrolls, or unintended item/tab activations.
findings.root_cause: GameCanvas.update() calls panel/panel2.updateKey() at lines 699-713 and then calls panel/panel2.updateKey() a second time in the else-if chain at lines 714-729 when chatTField is not shown.
findings.title: Double panel.updateKey() invocation in GameCanvas.update()

findings.impact: IndexOutOfRangeException crashes rendering whenever bigNumber_black is drawn at zoomLevel > 1.
findings.root_cause: mFont.init() instantiates bigNumber_black with id = 31 (line 360). bigColor(31) indexes a 7-element array (valid), but setTypePaint() allocates a 6-element Color[6] outline array and indexes `array[id - 25]` (6), throwing IndexOutOfRangeException.
findings.title: IndexOutOfRangeException in mFont.setTypePaint for bigNumber_black (id=31)

findings.impact: Key 15 stays stuck in keyHold/keyPressed after releasing Enter/OK, and numpad keys stay stuck in keyHold when isMoveNumberPad is false.
findings.root_cause: In mapKeyRelease, case -5 / 10 sets `keyHold[15] = true; keyPressed[15] = true;` (copy-pasted from mapKeyPress) instead of false/released. Also mapKeyPress records numpad keys 1-8 without checking `isMoveNumberPad`, while mapKeyRelease only clears them if `isMoveNumberPad` is true.
findings.title: Stuck keyHold/keyPressed state in mapKeyRelease and asymmetric isMoveNumberPad check

findings.impact: Mouse press/drag/release events fire multiple times per Unity frame (Layout, Repaint, MouseDown, etc.), causing missed or duplicate clicks and wasted work.
findings.root_cause: OnGUI() invokes checkInput() on every IMGUI event pass, and checkInput() polls frame-level Input.GetMouseButtonDown/GetMouseButton/GetMouseButtonUp(0) and Input.GetAxis("Mouse ScrollWheel") instead of guarding by Event.current.type.
findings.title: Frame-level Input.GetMouseButton* polled on every OnGUI pass in Main.checkInput()

findings.impact: Causes continuous GC allocations during combat/damage rendering on every frame at zoomLevel > 1, plus 5x GUI.Label draw calls per string.
findings.root_cause: setTypePaint allocates `new Color[6]` and calls bigColor() twice (each allocating `new Color[7]`) on every call for id > 24, alongside 5 `_drawString` passes per outlined text/number.
findings.title: Per-frame Color[] heap allocations in mFont.setTypePaint and bigColor

findings.impact: Orphans a Texture2D GPU/native allocation on every Image.createImage(Image) call and leaks sampled Textures in loadBG until scene unload.
findings.root_cause: Image.createImage(Image img) calls createImage(img.w, img.h) (allocating a new Texture2D) and immediately overwrites `image.texture = img.texture` without destroying the allocated Texture2D, then calls Apply() again. GameCanvas.loadBG loads a temporary Image to read 1 pixel via getRGB without destroying its texture.
findings.title: Texture2D native memory leak in Image.createImage(Image) and loadBG

findings.impact: Throws NullReferenceException when dragons/fireworks render before imgBG is initialized (e.g. lowGraphic or loading). Also sets wrong yfog on map transition.
findings.root_cause: paintBackgroundtLayer accesses `imgBG.Length` at line 1145 before the null check `imgBG == null` at line 1161. In loadBG(int typeBG), line 1709 checks static `typeBg == 12` before assigning `typeBg = typeBG` at line 1728, reading the previous map's background type.
findings.title: NullReferenceException in paintBackgroundtLayer and stale typeBg read in loadBG

findings.impact: Double draw cost every frame a dialog is open and visual double-darkening of semi-transparent dialog backdrops.
findings.root_cause: GameCanvas.paint() paints `currentDialog.paint(g)` at line 2743 and paints it a second time at line 2779.
findings.title: currentDialog.paint(g) called twice per frame in GameCanvas.paint()

findings.impact: Can throw IndexOutOfRangeException during word wrapping (caught and logged as warning, falling back to unsplit line), or freeze the client if lineWidth < 1 char width.
findings.root_cause: splitStrInLineA increments `num++` at line 683 and immediately accesses `src[num]` at line 684 without bounds check; splitFontVector has no progress guarantee if `num == 0` when `getWidth(1 char) > lineWidth`.
findings.title: Off-by-one IndexOutOfRangeException in splitStrInLineA and potential infinite loop in splitFontVector

findings.impact: Generates per-frame GC garbage in paint/input loops (Position object on every drag, string concats on HUD money/loading/text comparison).
findings.root_cause: pointerDragged allocates `new Position(x, y)` instead of reusing existing elements; getMoneys allocates multiple concatenated strings in a loop; paint/paintChangeMap build strings via `+`; mFont.compare allocates `string.Empty + strSource[i]` per character.
findings.title: Per-frame allocations in GameCanvas pointerDragged/paint/getMoneys and mFont.compare

findings.impact: Floods Unity Console with false red error badges during normal image loading and slows network message pumping to 15 Hz when window loses focus.
findings.root_cause: Image.loadData unconditionally calls `Debug.LogError("CHIEU DAI MANG BYTE IMAGE CREAT = " + array.Length)` after an unused `ArrayCast.cast`. Main.OnApplicationFocus(false) sets `Application.targetFrameRate = 15`, throttling Update() where Session_ME.update() drains network packets.
findings.title: False Debug.LogError in Image.loadData and network throttling on focus loss in Main.cs

findings.impact: Race condition if concurrent threads ever invoke `_createImage*`, and wasted per-tick check in Main.FixedUpdate(). Also potential NRE in Main.Awake/closeKeyBoard/parse.
findings.root_cause: Image._createImage* and Image.update() share unsynchronized non-volatile static fields with Thread.Sleep(5) polling (though currently unused by public callers). Main.Awake doesn't set `main = this`. Main.closeKeyBoard/OnApplicationPause dereference TField.kb without null check. GameCanvas.perform case 888391 calls `int.Parse(s)` without try/catch.
findings.title: Unsynchronized static IPC mailbox in Image.cs and missing null/parse guards in Main/GameCanvas

module_summary: Read all 4 files (5,676 lines) in the client core & rendering batch: Main.cs (Unity MonoBehaviour lifecycle & input bridge), GameCanvas.cs (central UI/game loop, input map, map background/weather renderer, dialog/action dispatcher), Image.cs (Texture2D image loader/slicer), and mFont.cs (bitmap & Unity Font/GUIStyle text rendering and word-wrapping). Observed high-impact UI/input/rendering bugs (double panel.updateKey(), double currentDialog.paint(), stuck keyHold[15], OnGUI frame-input polling), a crash bug in mFont.setTypePaint for bigNumber_black (id=31), per-frame Color[]/Position/string GC allocations in rendering, and Texture2D leaks/false LogError in Image.cs.
